name: rain-sensor
author: Vicky Sigler
body:
<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 360 220' width='360' height='220'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='pcbBlue' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#0b7ee8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#064fae'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='plateBlack' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#080808'/>
      <stop offset='0.55' stop-color='#161616'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#050505'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='silver' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='0.45' stop-color='#cfcfcf'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f5f5f5'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <ellipse cx='236' cy='205' rx='112' ry='9' fill='#000' opacity='0.11'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='203' rx='48' ry='7' fill='#000' opacity='0.10'/>

  <!-- two probe wires -->
  <path d='M45 22 C78 11 114 24 151 38' fill='none' stroke='#bcbcbc' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 22 C89 15 125 30 165 42' fill='none' stroke='#d8d8d8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- LM393 module board -->
  <g>
    <rect x='18' y='39' width='92' height='154' rx='6' fill='url(#pcbBlue)' stroke='#063f8b' stroke-width='2'/>
    <rect x='21' y='42' width='86' height='148' rx='4' fill='none' stroke='#35a7ff' stroke-opacity='0.35'/>

    <!-- top 2-pin probe header -->
    <line x1='45' y1='19' x2='45' y2='39' stroke='#c7c7c7' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='60' y1='19' x2='60' y2='39' stroke='#c7c7c7' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <rect x='36' y='38' width='33' height='13' rx='2' fill='#161616' stroke='#2d2d2d'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='44.5' r='3' fill='#e9e9e9' stroke='#999' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='44.5' r='3' fill='#e9e9e9' stroke='#999' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <text x='73' y='48' font-size='7' font-family='monospace' fill='#d8f0ff'>PROBE</text>

    <!-- mounting holes -->
    <circle cx='31' cy='55' r='5.4' fill='#e9f7ff' stroke='#0a3b70' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='96' cy='178' r='5.4' fill='#e9f7ff' stroke='#0a3b70' stroke-width='2'/>

    <!-- potentiometer -->
    <rect x='43' y='64' width='41' height='40' rx='4' fill='#1a8bea' stroke='#0b376f' stroke-width='2'/>
    <rect x='49' y='69' width='29' height='29' rx='3' fill='#45a9ff' opacity='0.45'/>
    <circle cx='63.5' cy='84' r='13' fill='#f2f6f9' stroke='#b8c3ca' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='57' y1='90' x2='70' y2='78' stroke='#6f7d86' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

    <!-- components -->
    <rect x='29' y='78' width='17' height='6' rx='2' fill='#d9b36b' stroke='#8c6730' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='25' y1='81' x2='29' y2='81' stroke='#cfd8dc' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <line x1='46' y1='81' x2='50' y2='81' stroke='#cfd8dc' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <rect x='82' y='93' width='17' height='6' rx='2' fill='#d9b36b' stroke='#8c6730' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='78' y1='96' x2='82' y2='96' stroke='#cfd8dc' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <line x1='99' y1='96' x2='104' y2='96' stroke='#cfd8dc' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <rect x='29' y='104' width='13' height='10' rx='2' fill='#0c1a22' stroke='#6aaee8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <rect x='86' y='111' width='12' height='10' rx='2' fill='#0c1a22' stroke='#6aaee8' stroke-width='0.8'/>

    <!-- comparator IC -->
    <rect x='47' y='116' width='31' height='32' rx='3' fill='#101014' stroke='#303036' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <text x='52' y='134' font-size='6' font-family='monospace' fill='#777'>LM393</text>
    <line x1='47' y1='123' x2='38' y2='123' stroke='#c9c9c9' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='47' y1='130' x2='38' y2='130' stroke='#c9c9c9' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='47' y1='137' x2='38' y2='137' stroke='#c9c9c9' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='78' y1='123' x2='87' y2='123' stroke='#c9c9c9' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='78' y1='130' x2='87' y2='130' stroke='#c9c9c9' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='78' y1='137' x2='87' y2='137' stroke='#c9c9c9' stroke-width='2'/>

    <!-- LEDs -->
    <circle cx='35' cy='158' r='5' fill='#25df69' stroke='#b8ffd0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <text x='27' y='171' font-size='7' font-family='monospace' fill='#ffffff'>DO</text>
    <circle cx='89' cy='158' r='5' fill='#ff3b30' stroke='#ffd1cf' stroke-width='1'/>
    <text x='78' y='171' font-size='7' font-family='monospace' fill='#ffffff'>PWR</text>

    <!-- thin pcb traces -->
    <path d='M45 51 C45 59 37 62 37 75 L37 92 M60 51 C60 58 72 61 72 64 M63 104 L63 115 M84 84 C96 91 96 118 88 123 M34 114 C34 126 38 130 47 130 M77 137 C88 145 89 151 89 153' fill='none' stroke='#86d4ff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-opacity='0.55'/>

    <!-- 4-pin output header -->
    <text x='28' y='183' font-size='6.2' font-family='monospace' fill='#ffffff' font-weight='700'>VCC GND DO AO</text>
    <rect x='31' y='187' width='64' height='10' rx='2' fill='#131313'/>
    <line x1='39' y1='196' x2='39' y2='216' stroke='#c7c7c7' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='196' x2='54' y2='216' stroke='#c7c7c7' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='69' y1='196' x2='69' y2='216' stroke='#c7c7c7' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='84' y1='196' x2='84' y2='216' stroke='#c7c7c7' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='39' cy='192' r='2.6' fill='#efefef'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='192' r='2.6' fill='#efefef'/>
    <circle cx='69' cy='192' r='2.6' fill='#efefef'/>
    <circle cx='84' cy='192' r='2.6' fill='#efefef'/>
  </g>

  <!-- rain detector plate HW-028 -->
  <g transform='rotate(5 237 105)'>
    <rect x='139' y='14' width='196' height='181' rx='9' fill='url(#plateBlack)' stroke='#d7d7d7' stroke-width='2.4'/>
    <rect x='147' y='22' width='180' height='165' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#3f3f3f' stroke-width='1.2'/>

    <!-- mounting holes -->
    <circle cx='161' cy='36' r='13' fill='#ededed' stroke='#787878' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='161' cy='36' r='6.5' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#b4b4b4' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='313' cy='36' r='13' fill='#ededed' stroke='#787878' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='313' cy='36' r='6.5' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#b4b4b4' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='161' cy='174' r='13' fill='#ededed' stroke='#787878' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='161' cy='174' r='6.5' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#b4b4b4' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='313' cy='174' r='13' fill='#ededed' stroke='#787878' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='313' cy='174' r='6.5' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#b4b4b4' stroke-width='1.2'/>

    <!-- small connector pads/icon -->
    <rect x='178' y='30' width='25' height='15' rx='2' fill='#0a0a0a' stroke='#f0f0f0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <circle cx='185' cy='37.5' r='3.2' fill='url(#silver)'/>
    <circle cx='196' cy='37.5' r='3.2' fill='url(#silver)'/>
    <path d='M185 44 C185 52 169 52 169 62' fill='none' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M196 44 C196 52 211 52 211 62' fill='none' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

    <!-- interleaved silver rain traces -->
    <path d='M158 52 V159' fill='none' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M316 52 V159' fill='none' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='158' y1='52' x2='302' y2='52' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='172' y1='60' x2='316' y2='60' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='158' y1='68' x2='302' y2='68' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='172' y1='76' x2='316' y2='76' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='158' y1='84' x2='302' y2='84' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='172' y1='92' x2='316' y2='92' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='158' y1='100' x2='302' y2='100' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='172' y1='108' x2='316' y2='108' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='158' y1='116' x2='302' y2='116' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='172' y1='124' x2='316' y2='124' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='158' y1='132' x2='302' y2='132' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='172' y1='140' x2='316' y2='140' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='158' y1='148' x2='302' y2='148' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='172' y1='156' x2='316' y2='156' stroke='url(#silver)' stroke-width='4.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

    <!-- board labels -->
    <text x='268' y='180' font-size='13' font-family='monospace' fill='#ffffff' font-weight='700'>HW-028</text>
    <text x='209' y='39' font-size='7' font-family='monospace' fill='#eeeeee'>RAIN</text>
  </g>
</svg>
